raw_text:
Disease: Alternaria_leaf_spot

Visible observations:
- Numerous distinct circular to irregular brown spots scattered across the green leaf surface
- Visible concentric rings (target-board pattern) inside several of the larger lesions
- Coalescence of multiple spots creating larger irregular necrotic areas near the margins
- Dry necrotic tissue within lesion centers

Diagnostic evidence:
- Prominent target-board concentric rings inside leaf spots
- Tan to light brown dry necrotic centers within well-defined lesion borders
- Scattered circular spot distribution across the leaf blade

Reasoning:
The photograph displays characteristic visual features of Alternaria leaf spot, specifically the abundance of circular brown lesions exhibiting distinct concentric rings (target-board pattern) and tan necrotic centers scattered across the leaf blade. Some spots coalesce into larger necrotic patches, which matches the expected symptomology for this disease class.
